title: QUIC RFC 9000 NEW_CONNECTION_ID Frame Focused Proof Verification
verification_method: Focused S19P15 requirement-home tests, Release build, full Release no-build solution tests, QuicFrameCodec benchmark Dry run, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers NEW_CONNECTION_ID parser and formatter behavior, field order, 8-bit Length handling, Connection ID length boundaries, and the 16-byte Stateless Reset Token field for RFC 9000 Section 19.15 requirements 0001 through 0013.
expected_result: Focused S19P15 requirement homes prove that NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames use type 0x18, preserve Sequence Number and Retire Prior To variable-length integer fields, encode Length as one 8-bit unsigned field, preserve Connection ID bytes of the declared length, require a 16-byte Stateless Reset Token, reject malformed/truncated/out-of-range encodings, and keep parser/format hot paths covered by the existing frame-codec benchmark suite.
procedure: Run the focused S19P15 requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release no-build solution test suite.
Run the QuicFrameCodec benchmark suite with BenchmarkDotNet Dry job.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The existing QuicFrameCodec NEW_CONNECTION_ID parser and formatter are the runtime seam under test.
Existing peer connection-ID lifecycle artifacts remain the owner for S19P15 requirements 0014 through 0023.
The existing QuicFrameCodecBenchmarks suite remains the hot-path benchmark evidence for NEW_CONNECTION_ID parse and format operations.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim broader peer connection-ID lifecycle closure, migration success, stateless reset token generation policy, or endpoint-host close-packet behavior beyond the parser and formatter seams.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-05. The focused S19P15 filter passed 65/65, generated triage reports 23/23 S19P15 requirements as trace_clean, Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, core SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 388 artifacts, the full Release no-build solution suite passed 4148/4148, and the QuicFrameCodec BenchmarkDotNet Dry run completed 12/12 benchmarks including ParseNewConnectionIdFrame at 1.028 ms and FormatNewConnectionIdFrame at 357.8 us with no allocations.
